+-------+                              +-----+                        +---------+
| Alice |                              | Bob |                        | Charlie |
+---+---+                              +--+--+                        +----+----+
    |                                     |                                |
    | 1. Solid arrow self-reference       |                                |
    +--+                                  |                                |
    |  |                                  |                                |
    |<-+                                  |                                |
    |                                     |                                |
    |                                     | 2. Dotted arrow self-reference |
    |                                     +..+                             |
    |                                     |  |                             |
    |                                     |<.+                             |
    |                                     |                                |
    |                                     |                                | 3. Open arrow self-reference
    |                                     |                                +--+
    |                                     |                                |  |
    |                                     |                                |--+
    |                                     |                                |
    | 4. Dotted open arrow self-reference |                                |
    +..+                                  |                                |
    |  |                                  |                                |
    |..+                                  |                                |
    |                                     |                                |
    |                                     | 5. Cross arrow self-reference  |
    |                                     +--+                             |
    |                                     |  |                             |
    |                                     |x-+                             |
    |                                     |                                |
    |                                     |                                | 6. Dotted cross self-reference
    |                                     |                                +..+
    |                                     |                                |  |
    |                                     |                                |x.+
    |                                     |                                |
